description: Find every doubled letter in your text — 'bookkeeper' style — with the word and exact character positions.

faqs.a: A doubled letter is the same letter twice in a row, like the 'tt' in 'letter' or 'ee' in 'bookkeeper' (which has three doubles!).
faqs.q: What counts as a doubled letter?

faqs.a: For each word containing doubles, the tool lists the word, the doubled letter, and its character positions in the text.
Yes — matching is case-insensitive, so 'LL' and 'll' both count.

howto: Review each word, letter, and position.
title: Double Letter Finder
